query:
SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM conversation_participant cp
            JOIN conversation c ON c.id = cp.conversation_id
            WHERE cp.user_id = $1
              AND cp.last_read_at < c.last_message_at
              AND (
                  SELECT m.sender_id
                  FROM message m
                  WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id
                  ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC
                  LIMIT 1
              ) != $1
        ) AS "exists!"
